about: Apply for the yearly unified medical and dental internship in DHA-accredited facilities. For healthcare professionals only.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for healthcare professionals (doctors, dentists, nurses and similar), not for patients or the general public
For medical or dental graduates of internationally recognised institutions
documents: English test result such as TOEFL 550, IELTS Academic 6 or OET 300
ECE evaluation for degrees from outside the UAE
fees: AED 30,000 training fee for the medical programme
Dental training fee is set by the institution
timing: About two months after all requirements are complete
